title: Atoms, Molecules and the Mole
summary: Grade 9: the laws of chemical combination, electron arrangement and valency, ions and formulae, molecular mass, and counting particles with the mole.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Atoms combine in fixed ratios, so chemists can count particles by weighing them and predict the formulae and amounts of the substances they make.

factual: What are the laws of chemical combination?
conceptual: How do electron arrangements explain valency?
Why do chemists count particles in moles rather than one by one?
debatable: Was Dalton's atomic theory 'wrong' because atoms can be split?
